nodes.title: SG-1 · Remove worker module and execution backend
nodes.body:
Context: Worldseed is a game and contribution project, not a development platform. The separate Go module backend/worker (with its own go.mod) and the package backend/internal/execution (imported by backend/internal/server/server.go) are development automation. Desired behavior: both are deleted, nothing under backend/ imports them, and the remaining packages (contribution, round, player, world, admin, gitrepo, safepath) still compile. Why: devion project workseed owns development automation.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the repo after the change, when backend/worker is looked up, then the directory and its go.mod do not exist.
- Given the repo after the change, when backend/internal/execution is looked up, then the directory does not exist.
- Given the remaining backend packages, when they are built and tested, then they compile and pass, and no Go file under backend/ imports the worker module or internal/execution.


## Scope
- In scope: Delete backend/worker
- In scope: Delete backend/internal/execution and its handler
- In scope: Remove execution wiring and execution admin routes from backend/internal/server
- Out of scope: Frontend ExecutionPanel and admin UI removal
- Out of scope: Config key cleanup beyond what compiles
- Out of scope: Contribution handoff export format
- Preserve: backend/internal/contribution, round, player, world, admin, gitrepo, safepath
- Preserve: game/src, game/frontend, game/content


## Technical constraints
- Go module github.com/worldseed/storyforge/backend must keep building with go build ./...


## Definition of done
- All acceptance criteria are met
- Backend unit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · The worker Go module is deleted from backend/

- Out of scope: backend/internal packages
- Preserve: backend/go.mod

nodes.title: REQ · Server serves only round admin routes and the backend compiles without execution code
nodes.body:
Context: backend/internal/server/server.go imports internal/execution, builds exStore and eh, and adminRoutes returns /executions, /executions/{id}/retry and /executions/{id}/approve before the round routes. Desired behavior: those imports, variables and routes are removed and New mounts adminRoundRoutes(rh) behind admin.Middleware. Expected result: remaining packages compile and tests pass. Why: nothing may import removed code.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given server.New, when the router is walked, then /api/v1/admin serves exactly the five round routes and no /executions route.
- Given any Go file under backend/, when imports are read, then none import internal/execution.
- Given go build ./... and go test for server, then both succeed.


## Scope
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server.go
- In scope: backend/internal/server/server_test.go
- Out of scope: Frontend admin client
- Preserve: Round admin routes and token middleware
- Preserve: contribution and world routes
- Preserve: NewScheduler


## Technical constraints
- Admin routes stay behind admin.Middleware(cfg.Admin.Token)


## Definition of done
- Server builds and its tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

steps.action: Create the file with package server and TestWorkerModuleRemoved: os.Stat("../../worker") must return os.IsNotExist; then filepath.WalkDir("../..") over *.go files and fail if any file content contains "storyforge/worker" (skip removed_code_test.go itself).
